C-TEACHING-CLOSE-PATH-1-3E91B69F.Problem: Two staged findings name this increment as their teacher. `F306` measured that the supersede path is untaught: neither `ngrace-spec` nor `ngrace-plan` said that `spec new --supersedes` mints a throwaway skeleton the author overwrites from the archived predecessor's bytes with `status` reset to `draft` and the verb-inserted `Replacement` child dropped; that the `mint-search` line printed at mint, while the predecessor is still active and counted, is the value carried verbatim by whatever consumes it later and never re-derived after the move; or that the predecessor's own archive arrival joins every archive-edit criterion's exclude. Its executor-reported items were re-measured here: `--assertions final` without `--run-commands` does refuse when the target declares a `MustPassCommand`; `gate apply` does refuse `gate.apply.no-verdict` until a verdict is recorded, and the post-archive verdict carrying one `--ack-finding` per displayed `review.close-evidence-unevaluated` is what evaluates `CloseEvidence`; a faithful copy without `.git` cannot evaluate a single `git diff` criterion, and an ignored directory reached through a symlink needs a bare `.git/info/exclude` entry. `F311` measured that `ngrace-execute` misdescribes two mechanics: `--run-commands` does not require an open epoch — it resolves a declared task from an explicit task, a loose event, `run.xml`, or the last folded ledger event — and the final `--run-commands` does not open a fresh epoch; it writes allocation-less `command-run` events the next fold covers by synthesis. The same day collected four more executor-side mechanics: the post-write `MODULE_MAP` check runs as the selected-baseline lint; a pass-only attempt surfaces as an info-level `review.attempt-pair-unpaired-pass` the default severity hides while the audit line counts it; a red reaching a not-yet-existing export must go through a namespace import with an optional call or the whole test file fails to load; and a correction to a passed task opens a new epoch on that task while the end-state terminal stays on the plan's last task. One more was collected for the verifying party: `xmllint` rejects documents whose comments contain `--` and silently under-counts, so a structural census goes through the shipped parser.
